versions.changelog:
Initial release of hoodie-designer, an AI-powered tool for custom hoodie and sweatshirt design.

- Generate personalized hoodie/sweatshirt designs for print and manufacturing on demand.
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, custom text, logos, and interactive 3D design generation.
- Multi-view previews and interactive 3D viewers included in the workflow.
- Offers API endpoint for generating design drafts from text prompts, images, and template IDs.
- Integrates with Craftsman Agent Manufacturing Platform for prototyping and supplier matching.
